Name: DE-ProjectsTypes
Statement:
select  prt.Oid as DocumentOid,
        prt.Oid as ProjectTypeId,
        prt.Name as ProjectType,
        com.name as Company,
        com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        dct.Name as DocumentType,
        prt.TemplateFileName,
        prt.AllowsTimesheet,
        prt.IsDeliverable,
        prt.Active
from    ProjectNature prt, Company com, DocumentType dct
where   prt.company = com.oid and 
        prt.DocumentType = dct.Oid
